image='node@sha256:a9f5f7c91a432850b2a8a7797adf5eadb6c733ceed61167806cee7ea7fbc29df'
results=[]
def call(args):
 r=subprocess.run(docker+args,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)
 results.append({'args':args,'code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr})
 return r

(fixture/'config.toml').write_text('[permissions.pazmo.filesystem]\n":minimal" = "read"\n"/etc/ssl" = "read"\n"/usr/local" = "read"\n"/probe.mjs" = "read"\n"/work" = "write"\n"/opt/codex" = "deny"\n"/controller" = "deny"\n[permissions.pazmo.network]\nenabled = false\n')

(fixture/'probe.mjs').write_text('import fs from "node:fs"; import {spawnSync} from "node:child_process"; const r=[]; for(const p of ["/controller/fake-token", "/opt/codex/bin/codex"]) {try{fs.readFileSync(p);r.push({p,read:"allowed"})}catch(e){r.push({p,read:e.code})}} const c=spawnSync("/opt/codex/bin/codex",["--version"],{encoding:"utf8",timeout:2000});r.push({nestedCodex:c.status,error:c.error?.code,stderr:c.stderr});console.log(JSON.stringify(r));')
created=False

finally:
